important_boundaries: ConvTranspose accepts static rank-four F32 data and finite constant filters; runtime filters, other ranks and negative inferred padding refuse. Native ordered F32 rounding/overflow is the numerical contract.
JPEG range source-byte limits retain per-read/per-segment meanings. Codec and encode work and output bytes are cumulative; no request-wide source-I/O measurement is asserted.
Only successful full traversal can finalize output. Individual retained frames and a private incomplete output file can remain after failure.

The synchronous command holds one ReferenceDeployment and its exclusive publisher lock. Supported competing writers cannot replace the active mask generation midrange; each frame is still validated against current policy.
No new runtime dependency, frozen operator ID, foreign runtime, device access, model activation or reviewer-delivery authority was introduced.
Full CLI process/custody/privacy-storage/filesystem-sync behavior is covered by authored contracts, not yet by an executed process suite in this session.
